subject: Chemistry
question: For the dibromo compound roadmap reaction sequence shown in the diagram, identify the starting reactant [P] (molecular formula : C9H10Br2): (see diagram)
explanation: Explanation: Structure (3) represents 1,2-dibromo-1-phenylpropane. Upon reaction with excess sodamide, it undergoes double dehydrohalogenation to form phenylpropyne, which on hydration with HgSO4/H2SO4 yields propiophenone. Propiophenone gives a positive iodoform test (keto group adjacent to ethyl/methyl? wait, phenylacetone gives iodoform, propiophenone does not? wait, phenylacetone C6H5CH2COCH3 has methyl ketone, so it gives positive iodoform. Hydration of 1-phenylpropyne yields benzyl methyl ketone, which gives positive iodoform but negative Tollen's test. Hence (3) is correct. Option A.
sourceFile: Haloalkanes and Haloarenes - JEE Main 2026 (Jan) - MathonGo.pdf

subject: Chemistry
question: Identify the correct decreasing order of reactivity of the following haloarenes A, B, C, D towards nucleophilic substitution with aqueous NaOH: (see diagram)
explanation: Explanation: Nucleophilic aromatic substitution rate increases with electron-withdrawing groups (-I, -M) ortho/para to the leaving group. D has two -NO2 groups (ortho and para, most reactive). B has one -NO2 group (para). A has no substituents. C has a methoxy group (-OMe, electron donating, least reactive). Hence D > B > A > C. Option A.

subject: Chemistry
question: For the organic chloride compound reacting with AgNO3 shown in the diagram, find the number of moles of AgCl precipitated at room temperature: (see diagram)
explanation: Explanation: The compound contains three chlorines. The chlorine on the benzene ring and the vinylic chlorine are completely inert to nucleophilic substitution via AgNO3. Only the tertiary aliphatic chlorine undergoes rapid SN1 ionization at room temperature to form a stable carbocation and precipitate 1 mole of AgCl. Option A.
